description_en: Batch peeks at messages in a queue without changing the message status
description_zh: 批量查看队列中的消息，不改变消息状态
kebab_example: aliyun smqproxy batch-peek-message --queue-name test-queue --peekonly true --num-of-messages 16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchPeekMessage

parameters.help_en: Indicates that this request only peeks at messages at the top of the queue without changing the message status. Fixed value: true
parameters.help_zh: 表示这次请求只是去查看队列顶部的消息并不会引起消息的状态改变。取值固定为true
parameters.name: peekonly

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of messages to peek at in this BatchPeekMessage request
parameters.help_zh: 本次BatchPeekMessage最多查看消息条数
parameters.name: num_of_messages

v1_parameters.help_en: The maximum number of messages to peek at in this BatchPeekMessage request
v1_parameters.help_zh: 本次BatchPeekMessage最多查看消息条数
v1_parameters.name: numOfMessages
